cases.name: Deterministic audit oracles and sealed data
steps: Request sealed test before token use

Upload capstone-support-v1 twice under different names with sealed_test.jsonl as the test part; upload documents.jsonl as a retrieval_v1 train part; upload a document_text_v1 file whose record 17 is whitespace-only; evaluate the sealed test split without a token; create a capstone attempt with a wrong dataset_manifest_sha256.
expected: Training and premature sealed access rejected without mutation

Both uploads have sealed test splits and the same manifest_sha256, so the exposure ledger key is shared; the retrieval corpus registers with eligibility eligible and empty rejections; the whitespace record rejects the whole upload with 400 VALIDATION_FAILED reason SEMANTIC_INVALID and a line-17 field error; the tokenless evaluation returns 409 STATE_CONFLICT reason SEALED_SPLIT_REQUIRES_TOKEN; the wrong digest returns 400 VALIDATION_FAILED reason DATASET_DIGEST_MISMATCH.

cases.name: All schemas and rejection atomicity
steps: Submit invalid object through each import boundary

Preview a 3,000,000-byte legacy v1 backup exported by the preserved app with 20 runs; a 25,000,001-byte legacy file; a legacy backup missing one of the ten note fields; a legacy backup with a reviewed evidence entry whose note is blank.
expected: Valid fixtures pass and invalid fail

The 3,000,000-byte backup previews; 25,000,001 bytes returns 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE; the other two return 400 VALIDATION_FAILED/SCHEMA_INVALID exactly where the preserved validateState rejects them; the localStorage key llm-foundations-v1 is never written.

cases.name: Evidence snapshots, citation bounds and completion derivation
preconditions: Registered module evidence artifacts, note revisions and retrieval index/query results.
steps: Submit each of the 12 exact requirement/profile pairs; reject a cross-pair and retired umbrella profile.
Submit CUR-012 with one earlier plan note; edit/delete source note and read unchanged evidence snapshot.
Submit E02 six citations; reject duplicate/out-of-order query IDs, a byte range inside a multibyte scalar, wrong support document and absent structured_response.
Import a forged complete evidence record and check claim downgrade; verify current local CUR-012 with all prerequisites.
expected: Only exact pairs dispatch; snapshots bind exact original bytes/revision; no inference about prose truth.
Invalid E02 spans/pairs grant no verification. Completion derives only from current local verified CUR-012; imported flags grant no credit.
